name: Five sequential bracket-cell clicks land on five distinct match detail pages
description: When a visitor returns to the homepage between clicks and clicks five different cells in the bracket, every destination renders a real match detail page and the five destinations are distinct — proving deep links into matches work for at least five distinct fixtures, not just one cherry-picked entry.

planSteps.description: Scroll down to the knockout bracket section
Click the first cell in the bracket
Note the current match detail URL as destination 1
Click a second, different cell in the bracket
Note the current match detail URL as destination 2
Click a third, different cell in the bracket
Note the current match detail URL as destination 3
Click a fourth, different cell in the bracket
Note the current match detail URL as destination 4
Click a fifth, different cell in the bracket
Verify the fifth destination renders real match-detail content (kickoff time, venue, or team names), not a blank or error page
Verify the five noted destination URLs are all distinct from each other
